display.title: Episode 509: Saved by a Miracle (Chof-Daled Teves)
display.summary_short: On the Alter Rebbe's yahrzeit, Uncle Yossi urges good resolutions, then tells how a Chassid falsely accused of theft was saved by following the Alter Rebbe's puzzling advice.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on Chof-Daled Teves, the yahrzeit of the Alter Rebbe. Uncle Yossi explains that a tzaddik's yahrzeit is a time for strong resolutions: learn more Torah, do more mitzvos, and help a friend or relative do the same, which is true Ahavas Yisroel. After the Hakochainik march, a young out-of-town guest says the Shema in Studio 604 and talks about her learning, followed by the weekly tzedakah. Story time tells of Reb Boruch, an honest supervisor in a government lumberyard. A jealous, cruel man hides twenty stolen railroad logs in his barn and accuses him to the minister. Reb Boruch is summoned to appear on Tuesday at eight, but the Alter Rebbe tells him to come back a week later before going. When he finally arrives, the minister reveals that an officer had been waiting that Tuesday to shoot him, and that witnesses have since cleared his name. His trust in the tzaddik saved his life.
display.lesson: Trust in Hashem and in the guidance of a tzaddik, who sees things as they truly are; and on a tzaddik's yahrzeit, take on good resolutions.

date.note: 'As we look at our calendar, it's Chof-Daled Teves'; 24 Teves 5752 was a Tuesday, one week after episode 508 (Shemos).

advisories.note: A Jew is falsely accused of theft; people summoned by the government were jailed or disappeared, and an officer was ordered to shoot him.

segments.title: Chof-Daled Teves: Resolutions on the Alter Rebbe's Yahrzeit
segments.summary: On a tzaddik's yahrzeit we take on good resolutions and help others learn more Torah and do more mitzvos.

segments.title: Saved by a Miracle
segments.summary: A Chassid falsely accused of stealing government logs follows the Alter Rebbe's advice to delay his summons, and his life is saved.
